title: Building something exciting and looking for people to join!
author: Background_Pain1720
selftext:
I’m training an AI model on NEPSE market data from 2012 to May 2026 with OHLC across multiple timeframes (15- 30 min to daily, to weekly) and broker floor sheet data.

Right now the win rate is around 69% which is roughly 7 out of every 10 trades hitting their target. 

If you’re into algo trading, data, or NEPSE market analysis, let’s connect and build a community around this. Whether you have ideas, data, or just curiosity,  you’re welcome.

Drop a comment or DM me. Let’s grow this together! 👇

\#NEPSE #AlgoTrading #AI #MachineLearning #TradingCommunity
